long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The bowl is empty until morning, so I will take the high place and keep an eye on the beach.
Once dusk comes I will go to the telescope, since the sky is worth looking at.
I will look over the telescope while nobody is watching, as if I had not been waiting for it.

today.reason: Sitting by the empty bowl gets me nothing until morning, so I am moving to the high place and then the telescope.
